name: Reaper Shade removes movement impairing effects (#2170)
contract: Shade 573038 reads 'Become a shade, entering an improved stealth mode for $d and entering Underwalk. Removes all movement impairing effects.'

Spell.dbc gives it Transform (effect 0, aura 56, self), a delayed trigger of Underwalk 800797 (effect 1, SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_TRIGGER_SPELL_DELAYED, native and implemented), and Mod Stealth (effect 2, aura 16, native).

None of those three effects, nor Underwalk's own Shapeshift/Stealth/Decrease Speed effects, dispel an existing root or slow, so the tooltip's 'Removes all movement impairing effects' clause had no handler anywhere in src/server/coa or the DBC chain.
aura_ascension_reaper_shade binds to the Transform effect (EFFECT_0) and calls the native Unit::RemoveMovementImpairingAuras(true) on real application.
Entangling Roots 339 and Frostbolt's own aura 116 are the codebase's established root/slow fixtures (see primalist-empowered-boons); both must be present before Shade and gone immediately after.
